lines: Commits on track/p-payout-dates (author tamagami-hi, no trailers): d1fcf9a feat(payouts): show when a payout was marked paid or failed; 24c84c9 fix(payouts): wait for a current outcome before saying no date (review-55 F1). d1fcf9a includes the approved admin 0.18.1 Improved note 'Payout cards show the paid date.' (last item).
What changed (d1fcf9a):

- Contract: new op listAdminWithdrawalPayoutOutcomes, GET /v1/admin/clients/{userId}/withdrawal-payout-outcomes, query {limit: AdminLimit 1-100, default 25}, data {userId, items: [{payoutId, state, paidAt|null, failedAt|null}]} (ISO strings), ADMIN_READ_ERRORS, in admin-maturity.ts ADMIN_MATURITY_OPERATIONS. AdminWithdrawalPayout and the early-exit payout untouched; generated OpenAPI diff is additions only; frontend generated operations +2 lines.

- Backend: adminMaturityRoutes.ts route with the payout list's READ_PERMISSIONS (client_position.write or client_values.read, no new permission, DEC-36); maturityRepository.listWithdrawalPayoutOutcomes reads id, state, paid_at, failed_at from withdrawal_operations where user_id = client, order created_at desc, id desc, limit; served by withdrawal_operations_user_history_idx (051). Covers maturity and early-exit rows (maturity_id null). No migration.

- Admin app: payoutOutcomeQueries.ts useWithdrawalPayoutOutcomes keyed qk.admin.clientWithdrawalPayoutOutcomes(userId) under ['admin','investor',userId] (limit 100, STALE.MONEY); one request per client page shared by every card. PayoutOutcomeDate.tsx, paid/failed cards only: 'Paid on <formatDate IST>' / 'Failed on <date>'; nothing while loading or refetching; 'Paid date unavailable' / 'Failure date unavailable' when the read fails or lacks the payout. Pending cards make no request. Outcome form, held writes and keys untouched.
- DEPLOY.md: one paragraph in Database rollback semantics after the 074 notes.

What changed (24c84c9, review-55 F1): an outcome item whose state differs from the card's state is treated like loading (nothing shown), unless that read has failed, which still shows the unavailable line (rule 4). MaturityPanel's reload and the early-exit card's onReload also invalidate the outcome query (useReloadPayoutOutcomes).

Rule 11: old admin apps never call the new route; listAdminWithdrawalPayouts and listAdminClientSipEarlyExits responses are unchanged (frozen-schema integration test parses full envelopes under v0.18.0 schemas, identical to v0.15.4 for the payout list). New admin app against a backend without the route gets 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND and shows the unavailable line; the form keeps working. No data written, no migration, no rollback boundary.
Tests (rule 10):

- backend/test/integration/payoutOutcomes.integration.test.ts (2 tests): paid time for a paid maturity payout, failed time for a failed early-exit payout, nulls for pending, only the client's own rows, newest first, limit=1 and limit=101 refused, support 403, no session 401; and the existing payout and early-exit lists parse under frozen released envelope schemas. Its test clock is fixed at 2099 instants: a fixed clock in the past makes expires_at (now + TTL) fall before the database-set completed_at and trips idempotency_records_expiry (expires_at > completed_at).

- frontend WithdrawalPayoutPanel.test.tsx (3 tests): one read for three cards, nothing while loading, 'Paid on 17 Nov 2026' / 'Failed on 16 Nov 2026' from UTC instants on the next IST day; a card the read still lists as pending shows nothing, then the paid date after the outcome query is invalidated; on a 404 both unavailable lines and the pending card still sends {state: paid, expectedVersion: 1}.
Red controls (each restored and cmp-identical to HEAD, tree clean after):

- d1fcf9a: f8376aa6 client filter dropped; 5bf6ec93 permission check dropped (support 200); 2cce9c5d paidAt always null; 57b18fec paidAt added to the existing payout list (frozen schema, unrecognized_keys); a8aaf5d6 date line unwired (both card tests red); a21d08af failure rendered as nothing.
- 24c84c9: db0c8edc state check removed from outcomeAt: the stale-outcome test red (2 passed, 1 failed).
Green checks, clean tree, Node 24 container:

- d1fcf9a: contracts npm ci, build, check 35c6a46d (98 tests); backend npm ci, check 84269638 (1209 tests, 102 files); backend test:integration --coverage.enabled=false de92c708 (605 tests, 77 files); frontend npm ci, check a73af751 (473 tests, 51 files); build:client d8cd1b7b; build:admin 5a12039e.
- 24c84c9 (frontend-only change): frontend npm ci, check 8b4840b4 (474 tests, 51 files); build:client 9c1a3117; build:admin 7f6f0dc4. Contracts and backend unchanged since d1fcf9a.
Runtime steps for the coordinator:

- On a client page with two pending payouts (maturity or early exit), mark one paid and one failed: the cards read 'Paid on <today IST>' and 'Failed on <today IST>' under the amount; pending cards show no date line.

- Answer GET /v1/admin/clients/{userId}/withdrawal-payout-outcomes with 404 (or block it): paid/failed cards read 'Paid date unavailable' / 'Failure date unavailable', the page and other cards load, and a pending card's Record transfer outcome still works.
- After a held payout outcome, use 'Reload the payouts': the outcome request is sent again and the card shows the date, not the unavailable line.
- Network tab: one outcomes request per client page (limit=100), refetched after an outcome is recorded or a reload.
Doubtful or left:
- A client with more than 100 payouts would show the unavailable line on the oldest cards (read capped at 100 like the payout list); no cursor was added.
- Generated OpenAPI and operations may conflict with p-terms-version on landing; regenerate, do not hand-merge.
- Not runtime-verified in a browser; evidence is TESTED only.
